column1: # Game profile for Pokemon Pokopia (Nintendo Switch 2, title 0400A3A01EE4C000, update v327680): identity, modules, memory layout and shader groups.
# Started from the provisional profile nxnative's scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py derives from a survey (dm/games/profile_guess.py); the SWITCH2 lines were set by hand during the port.
# Link Play (hle_coop_*.c): the DNS-SD service the module advertises; pack_app.py puts it and the local network text into the app's Info.plist
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# SWITCH2: Pokopia asks for total minus ~2.1 GiB and panics below ~7.9 GiB (Eden-NS2 memory experiment, PHASE-B.md)
# SWITCH2: Pokopia asks for total minus ~2.1 GiB and panics below ~7.9 GiB (Eden-NS2 memory experiment, PHASE-B.md)
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
# shader keys: the driver rewrites control +0x20..+0x27 of some sections at run time (6 of 71 requests of the first survey differed only there), so those bytes are hashed as zeros
# by nxnative's host and by s2_ctl_scan.py / s2_dumps.py (nxnative main with host/nxnative-switch2.patch applies the range to NVN2 sections' key bytes too)
# used memory for the current rewritten modules, at least the default 64 MB
# SWITCH2: the Mac bring-up ran the Metal 4 path (bases, pipeline archive), the Mac default; iOS turns it on only with this key
# pointer look (hle_hid.c): the camera turns at 110 deg/s times the right stick's tilt above a round deadzone of 0.51, frame-time based (measured from the view matrix)
# direct look (hle_hid.c look_cam): main build 816c5358..., main+0x34513d0 holds player 1's camera; pitch +0xb0 / yaw +0xb4, pitch limits +0xe4 / +0xe8,
# stick lock bytes +0x121 / +0x122 (bit 6 of +0x122 ignored). Found from memory diffs around known stick turns, confirmed on 6 fresh runs.
# 2.0.1 (main 76a489f3...): the same object, its slot at main+0x3561948 (found by its fingerprint: turn rates +0xdc/+0xe0, pitch limits +0xe4/+0xe8)
